column2: Thirteen years. That's how long fans have waited for a new Grand Theft Auto.
GTA Five came out in 2013, and sold over two hundred million copies.
The first GTA Six trailer pulled in over ninety million views in a single day.
GTA Six takes you to Leonida, a fictional Florida, with Vice City at its heart.
You follow two leads, Lucia and Jason, pulled into a criminal conspiracy.
First due in 2025, it slipped to May 2026, then to November nineteenth.
It's coming to PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S. No PC date yet.
After thirteen years, the wait is almost over.
